## What does this change?

<!-- A short description. Screenshots or exported card images are very welcome. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Translation (new language or improvement)
- [ ] Copy / wording
- [ ] Card design or template
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] All user-visible text is in `messages/*.json` (no hard-coded text in components)
- [ ] `npm run check:i18n && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Checked on a phone-sized screen (375px wide)
- [ ] If cards changed: I downloaded the PNG and checked the exported image, not just the preview
- [ ] No trackers, third-party scripts or new personal-data collection
- [ ] Nothing here conflicts with the [Charter](../CHARTER.md)

A maintainer will review this. Merging requires their approval; the website is published only
from approved changes on `main`. See [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md).
